latency_targets: p95 <= 120ms for chat primitives at 80 concurrent streams; p99 <= 300ms during sustained burst
throughput_requirements: Minimum sustained throughput guarantee: 2000 tokens/sec across reserved pool (measurement window 15m). Concurrency cap: 120 concurrent requests. Peak burst allowance: up to 5000 tokens/sec for up to 5 minutes, 2x/month without extra charge.
burst_policy: Burst allowed if pre-warmed KV cache present; bursts consume 'burst credits' bank. Policy requested: 2 free bursts/month (<=5min each), additional bursts billed at 20% uplift. Credits reset monthly. Bursts must not violate p95 latency targets; if they do, customer receives service credit.
reserved_gpu_plan: Initial proposal: reserve equivalent of 40 A100-80GB (can be mixture of A100/NVLink or newer instances) mapped to 10-GPU pools for redundancy. Autoscale headroom: +20% burst to shared regional pool; plan includes 2:1 safety concurrency buffer. Commit: 12 months with quarterly performance reviews.
sla_negotiation_notes: Measurement: tokens/sec computed at Redwood edge aggregated per-customer; 15-minute sliding window for compliance checks.
Credits: service credits if monthly availability < 99.5% OR sustained throughput < 90% of guaranteed for >30 minutes.
Penalties cap: credits capped at 20% of monthly fee; legal requested fixed rebate schedule.
Maintenance windows: prefer scheduled maintenance outside 01:00-05:00 PST; emergency maintenance allowed with 8h notice if critical.
Observability: customer requires token-level cost breakdown + per-route latency metrics exported to their SIEM/Grafana (endpoint + API key per tenant).
Fallback: automatic graceful fallback to smaller model variant (quantized) if Dedicated pool degraded; customer wants opt-in only after A/B test confirms quality within 2% of baseline.
Dispute resolution: measurement logs retained 90 days; Redwood to provide raw telemetry on request for disputes (SLA clause).
po_notes: Customer prefers monthly invoicing with usage reconciliation. Procurement to confirm PO by 2024-12-15. Legal wants explicit credit calculation appendix.

commercial_terms_summary: 12-month reserved commitment; base monthly fee covers guaranteed 2k t/s sustained. Burst quota: 2 free bursts/month (<=5min). Overage billed at negotiated rate. SLA credits for underperformance up to 20% cap. Security add-on (KMS + longer retention) priced separately.
